special_component_terms.conditions: Covered only if maximum capacity drops below 80% under 500 charge cycles without swelling
Covers manufacturer burn-in or touch controller failure without glass crack

allowed_fault_types.name: Touch Digitizer / Screen Sensor Failure
allowed_fault_types.description: Unresponsive touchscreen or ghost touches with intact glass cover

allowed_fault_types.name: Premature Battery Degradation
allowed_fault_types.description: Battery health drops < 80% within warranty period with documented diagnostic logs

allowed_fault_types.name: Camera Sensor / OIS Malfunction
allowed_fault_types.description: Focus motor failure, blurry sensor, or optical stabilization vibration without drop impact

allowed_fault_types.name: Cellular / WiFi / Bluetooth Module Fault
allowed_fault_types.description: Baseband modem failure, no service, or Wi-Fi greyed out

allowed_fault_types.name: Charging IC / Power Management Defect
allowed_fault_types.description: Device fails to accept charge despite undamaged USB-C / Lightning port

exclusions.title: Accidental Screen & Glass Cracking
exclusions.description: Cracked, shattered, or fractured front display glass or rear back glass from accidental drops

exclusions.title: Liquid Ingress or Submersion
exclusions.description: Red Liquid Contact Indicator (LCI) triggered or internal corrosion regardless of IP rating

exclusions.title: Non-OEM Battery or Screen Replacement
exclusions.description: Any previous uncertified part replacement, battery puncture, or jailbreak/root modification

exclusions.title: Bent Frame / Enclosure Stress
exclusions.description: Structural chassis warping or bending caused by pocket pressure or bending force

exclusions.title: Lost or Stolen Device
exclusions.description: Claims without the physical device or locked with activation lock / blacklisted IMEI
